name: Haunted Hearts
source:
To solve your own murder, you’ll need the help of three ghosts – and the only way to win them over is to seduce them.

[From [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.dorian.playtogether]Dorian app[/url]]
translation:
為了查清自己被殺的真相，你需要三個鬼魂的幫忙。讓它們站到你這邊的唯一辦法，就是色誘它們。

［取自[url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.dorian.playtogether]Dorian App[/url]］
